en.headline: Four vehicles collide on Tuen Mun Highway near Tai Lam
en.dek: Police said three people were slightly hurt and remained conscious after two taxis and two private cars collided late on Monday night.
body: Police said they received a report at 11:46pm on Monday from a taxi driver that four vehicles had collided on Tuen Mun Highway toward Tuen Mun, near Tai Lam.

The crash involved two taxis and two private cars, police said. Rescuers who arrived found three people with minor injuries. All three were conscious, and ambulance crews gave them initial treatment at the scene.

The Transport Department said some lanes on Tuen Mun Highway toward Tuen Mun near Tai Lam were closed after the collision, and drivers could use only the remaining lanes. Police are investigating the circumstances of the crash.

zh.headline: 屯門公路近大欖四車相撞 三人輕傷
zh.dek: 警方稱周一晚接報，屯門公路往屯門方向近大欖有兩輛的士及兩輛私家車相撞，三人受輕傷並保持清醒。
body: 警方表示，周一晚上11時46分接獲一名的士司機報案，指屯門公路往屯門方向近大欖發生四車相撞。
意外涉及兩輛的士及兩輛私家車。救援人員到場後，發現三人受輕傷，全部保持清醒，救護員在現場為他們作初步治理。
運輸署表示，屯門公路往屯門方向近大欖的部分行車線在意外後封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線。警方正調查意外經過。
